sample_unit: patients monitored in 4-month real clinical deployment

links.outcome: Prospective performance of the tuberculosis model in live clinical use after retrospective validation
links.effect: Real clinic deployment for 4 months, 692,949 patients monitored, 484 confirmed TB; model predicted 440 cases; positive recognition rate 90.91%, false-negative rate 3.83%.
links.quote: The MSI-PTDM prediction model was installed at a doctor workstation and operated in a real clinic environment for 4 months.

screen.reason: The study deployed the predictive decision-support model at a doctor workstation in an actual outpatient clinic environment for 4 months, monitoring nearly 700,000 patients and evaluating its real-world diagnostic performance.
